PC: Educational history (psycho-educational testing in school, past or present IEP, grade retentions, attendance)
Developmental history (language, early schooling and learning)
Home environment (structure of homework time, bedtime, recent stressors)
Recent changes (any recent external changes before this started)
Family history: LD, ADHD, parents’ education
Prior IEP (Individualized education program) evaluation and services like speech therapy in school.
Collateral from school: report card, SNAP/Vanderbilt (teacher)
Rule out hearing or vision impairment
What interventions have been effective or ineffective?
SBP: Assist parent in drafting letter requesting psychoeducational testing through the Committee for Special Education (CSE)
Write letter of support for CSE testing which parent can submit with the parent letter
F/U within 6 weeks + SW referral for families that may need additional support
Bring the letter requesting a CSE evaluation in person to the school
Encourage parent to get receipt from school when submitting letter to school
Follow-up on the request if you have not received information within one month
ICS: Educate parents on their role in advocating for their child, LD, educational rights
We can support you, but parents are the best advocates for their children
While awaiting the evaluation, encourage and help your child with his or her work but try to minimize the frustration and conflict at home
